metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: changes to its interface, such as a usage band and a Playwright progress band above the prompt

plugins.name: usage
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the 5-hour (orange) and weekly (blue) usage bars and, while its promotion runs, Fable's own weekly bar (purple), each with the time left until it renews; drawn as an SVG on VS Code and Claude Code Desktop, as text on the terminal

plugins.name: e2e-progress
plugins.description: A yellow band above the prompt with the progress of a Playwright run started from the session: tests done of the total, failures, flaky tests, time and the test running; its own reporter is added to the run, no project file changes
